entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Scaffolded Blazor identity UI does not work unless the containing application is installed at the website root #65633
  • Support internal request DTOs in built-in Minimal API validation #65632
  • Minimal API friendly version of `MapWhen` #65626
  • Dynamic component render #65624
  • SetIsOriginAllowedToAllowWildcardSubdomains ignores final / (path) for wildcard domains but not for exact matches #65623
  • SignalR JS w/ Azure SignalR Service incorrectly sends Azure SignalR JWT to application. #65620

Closed

  • Blazor Virtualize causes item re-rendering when using ItemsProvider with IQueryable data #65484
